prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic close-up golden-hour car selfie.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long brunette hair and light green eyes, playful expression, wearing an opaque white ribbed short-sleeve top with a seatbelt across her torso.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up selfie from a car seat, modern car interior, blurred road and trees through the window, natural posture and face-forward framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright warm golden-hour sunlight, high contrast, subtle lens flare, sun-kissed but natural skin texture and authentic car atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic iPhone 15 Pro, 8K-style detail, smartphone close-up, natural dynamic range, realistic grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic close-up selfie of an approved adult woman with long brunette hair and light green eyes sitting in a modern car seat. She wears an opaque white ribbed short-sleeve top with a seatbelt across her torso and has a playful natural expression. The car interior surrounds her, with a blurred road and trees visible through the window. Use bright natural golden-hour sunlight, high contrast, subtle lens flare, realistic detailed skin texture, natural proportions, and an iPhone 15 Pro 8K-style look.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, low neckline, exposed chest, tan-line emphasis, sexualized pout, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

assets.name: golden-hour-green-eyes_0.jpg
assets.usage: Car interior, seatbelt, brunette hair, green eyes, golden light, and selfie framing reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, eyes, car, seatbelt, warm light, and close-up framing; replace identity and wardrobe with approved equivalents when needed. No typography or logo is required.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced low-neck tank styling, tan-line emphasis, and sexualized pout with opaque coverage and a natural expression.
